# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Managed performance and retention fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves managed image, text-shaping, and stream handling performance. It reduces managed and native allocation pressure during pixel copies and feature-string decoding, while ensuring front-buffered streams do not retain data longer than necessary.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel copies optimized** — Reduces overhead when copying image pixels through the managed API, improving throughput for pixel-processing workloads. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text-shaping allocations reduced** — Pools UTF-32 encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocations without changing feature decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Fixes stream retention so buffered data is not kept alive longer than needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
